name: Eleanor Health
one_liner: Outpatient addiction treatment with medication (buprenorphine, naltrexone), therapy and peer support, by video or at clinics in 19 states.
best_for: Adults with opioid use disorder who want buprenorphine (Suboxone) with counseling
People with alcohol or other substance use plus anxiety or depression
People on Medicaid or Medicare looking for in-network addiction care
not_for: Anyone in crisis or at risk of overdose: call 911, or call or text 988
People who need inpatient detox or medically supervised withdrawal
short_description: Outpatient addiction and mental health care: medication for opioid and alcohol use disorder, therapy, psychiatry and peer recovery support, online or in clinic.
long_description: Eleanor Health is an outpatient provider for substance use disorders and co-occurring mental health conditions. Care teams of prescribers, therapists and peer recovery coaches offer medication for addiction treatment (including buprenorphine/Suboxone for opioid use disorder), individual and group therapy, psychiatry and help with practical needs. Most care is delivered by secure video by providers licensed in the member's state, and some states also have in-person clinics (for example Durham and Hickory, North Carolina, and San Antonio, Texas). Eleanor does not offer inpatient detox and refers people who need withdrawal management to local providers. It is in network with many commercial, Medicaid and Medicare plans and also offers self-pay. Its site lists 19 states where it currently accepts members.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance; $249/month self-pay medication program
pricing.notes: In network with many commercial, Medicaid and Medicare plans. Self-pay medication-for-addiction-treatment program is $249/month including medication management (medication cost not stated); some pages describe per-visit self-pay pricing instead.

privacy.notes: Policy (read 2026-10-27) covers HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 protections and says it won't sell or share SMS opt-in numbers for marketing, but says nothing about selling other data or advertising cookies; no deletion right stated.

faqs.a: Coverage varies by plan. Check with your insurance provider or the platform directly.

primary_uses: Buprenorphine treatment for opioid use disorder

patient_summary: You meet with an Eleanor prescriber, therapist and peer recovery coach, mostly by video, for medication treatment and counseling for opioid, alcohol or other substance use. You can usually start quickly by calling or filling out a form; Eleanor checks your insurance, including Medicaid and Medicare plans. Without insurance, its self-pay medication program is $249 per month.

availability.note: Accepts members in AZ, CO, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MA, MO, MT, NJ, NM, NC, OH, OK, PA, TX, WA and WI; mostly virtual with some in-person clinics. State lists differ across its pages.
